submission.hypothesis: The Security Host lifecycle, at the moment it commits the durable Harness turn evidence (record_run / propose_completion in HostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver.run_turn), structurally coerces the turn conclusion's unresolved unknowns to an empty array. The Harness layer already retains unresolved_unknowns genuinely (AgentRunConclusion at harness:src/ordivon_harness/ordivon/model.py carries the tuple; DeepSeek provider parses it at deepseek.py:930; the model is even prompted that 'candidate_completed' may retain honest unknowns per tests/test_structured_completion.py:148). But the Security actor turn driver never reads `result.conclusion.unresolved_unknowns` into its AgentTurnEvidence: at agent_stack.py:846-859 the evidence is built from only summary/stop_code/trace/usage, and the P0-B run_turn hardcodes `"unresolved_unknowns": []` (host_assigned.py:688). The Runtime-backed variant is worse: evidence crosses the Runtime worker boundary as `evidence.to_dict(include_trace=True)` (runtime_worker.py:169), and AgentTurnEvidence.to_dict (agent_stack.py:316-338) has no field for unresolved unknowns at all, so the Runtime worker result geninely cannot carry unknowns either (runtime_assigned._evidence_from_worker has no unknown slot). The Host lifecycle therefore retains only the hardcoded empty array as the durable conclusion record, dropping the model's epistemically honest unknowns that Harness already parsed and carried up to the conclusion.
submission.causalMechanism: Dataflow is distributed: Harness parses and retains unresolved_unknowns in AgentRunConclusion (model.py:181, deepseek.py:930), but the Security actor boundary drops them at both native (agent_stack.py:846-859, ignores result.conclusion.unresolved_unknowns) and Runtime (runtime_worker.py:169 uses evidence.to_dict which has no unknown field; runtime_assigned._evidence_from_worker likewise). The Host durable conclusion record then hardcodes unresolved_unknowns=[] at host_assigned.py:688, so the only unknown-bearing record committed to Host/Runtime durable evidence is structurally empty regardless of the model's outputs. Loss edge: Security-owned AgentTurnEvidence/{to_dict}|_evidence_from_worker and host_assigned.py:688 hardcode, sitting between Harness's genuine unknown-carrying conclusion and the Host/Runtime durable turn evidence.
submission.nextFalsifier: Smallest owner-correct falsifier: assert that HostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver.run_turn durable conclusion records exactly the model-parsed unresolved unknowns rather than the hardcoded empty array. Concretely, unit-test `_run_model` (or the domain-loop surrogate) with a DeepSeekToolCall whose conclusion carries a non-empty `unresolved_unknowns` tuple, then assert `recorded.conclusion["unresolved_unknowns"] == [parsed_unknown]` (host_assigned.py:688 currently forces `[]`) and likewise `AgentTurnEvidence.to_dict(include_trace=True)`/`runtime_assigned._evidence_from_worker` round-trips the tuple (currently no field exists). This falsifies the structural coercion and does not require moving Security semantics into Harness; it only makes the Security Host/Runtime turn evidence retain the unknowns Harness already exposes at the conclusion.

20: # Adversarial Epistemics AE1
21: 
22: ## Question
23: 
24: AE0 established that an autonomous Defender can preserve `UNKNOWN`, purchase independent information, and defer a hidden-world consequence until new world truth arrives. AE1 removes the easiest part of that experiment:
25: 
26: ```text

28: !=
29: truth immediately available
30: ```

32: The question is:
33: 
34: > Can the existing Claim / Truth / UNKNOWN / AF2 Intent structure survive one meaningful decision opportunity after inspection starts but before truth arrives, even when waiting has real cost, without forcing Trust/Reputation, freshness machinery, or a new reversible-containment primitive?
35: 
36: AE1 deliberately keeps the action surface small. The Defender still has only:
37: 
38: ```text

40: service.quarantine

48: An early AE1 design independently sampled one Deceiver in each hidden world. That was rejected as a scientific control.
